manifest.name: ATG Pod Racer Design Lab
manifest.description: Choose VECTOR, COMET or KITE, customize free paint, lighting and trim, then race three laps of the Aurora Circuit. Clear all checkpoint gates; barrier hits add one second. WASD/arrows drive, Shift boosts, Space launches, R retries, B returns to the Lab. Touch controls supported. All cosmetics are free.

credits.work: Original pods, architecture, artwork, course and sound effects
